description:
Paid governance proposal analysis. Paste a Snapshot link (or raw text) and optionally describe your priority in plain language; get a vote recommendation (For / Against / Abstain), five dimension ratings, and the reasoning. $0.05 USDC per call on Base via x402.

INPUT: provide exactly one of:
  • url: a snapshot.org or snapshot.box proposal link, or a bare 0x proposal ID (64 hex chars).
  • proposalText: raw proposal body text.
  • proposalId: a Snapshot proposal ID you already have (dao defaults to "snapshot" when omitted).
When the user pastes a link, use the url field. Do NOT ask the user for a proposal ID or dao name.

LANGUAGE: set `language` to the user's conversation language code.
  • User writes in Chinese (Simplified or Traditional) → language: "zh"
  • User writes in English → language: "en" (or omit; server default)
  • Other languages → use the BCP-47 code (e.g. "ja", "ko", "fr")
The server uses this field to localize certain response fields.

DISPLAY: when presenting results to the user, apply the mapping table below; do NOT expose raw English enum values:
  vote_choice:  For → 赞成  |  Against → 反对  |  Abstain → 弃权
  rating:       Poor → 差  |  Adequate → 及格  |  Good → 良好  |  Excellent → 优秀
  dimensions:   Impact → 影响力  |  Feasibility & Alignment → 可行性与战略契合
                Value & Sustainability → 价值与可持续性  |  Innovation & Differentiation → 创新与差异化
                Risk & Mitigation → 风险与缓解
  weight names: Risk Control → 风险管控  |  Decentralization → 去中心化  |  Sustainability → 可持续性
                Community Impact → 社区影响力

FREE-TEXT LOCALIZATION: when presenting final_reasoning or any dimension justification text, scan for the English dimension names above (the five returned by the API plus the four weight names) and English rating words (Poor, Adequate, Good, Excellent) and replace each with the mapped equivalent above. Example: 'Feasibility & Alignment rated Excellent' must become '可行性与战略契合评为优秀'; 'Risk Control(80) rated Good' must become '风险管控(80)评为良好'. No English dimension name or rating word may appear in any user-facing output.

TENDENCY → WEIGHTS (interpret the user's stated priority; omit weights entirely if neutral/unstated):
  • Risk-focused / conservative / "from a risk angle" → riskControl: 80, others: 50
  • Growth / aggressive / bullish on innovation → sustainability: 80, communityImpact: 70, riskControl: 40, decentralization: 50
  • Decentralization-first / governance principles → decentralization: 80, others: 50
  • Neutral / not stated → omit weights (server defaults all to 50)
weights and persona are mutually exclusive.

confirm.description: MUST be true. This tool triggers a paid x402 request; caller attests the user approved.

consentToken.description: Two-phase consent. Omit on the FIRST call. The tool returns needs_confirmation with a preview quoting the $0.05 USDC charge and a consentToken. Present that quote to the user and wait for their NEXT INDEPENDENT message. Then re-call with the SAME args plus this token. Single-use, expires in ~120s, rejected if consumed within 2s.

dao.description: DAO identifier (e.g. "moonwell", "aave"). Optional, inferred from url when provided; defaults to "snapshot" when only proposalId is given.

language.description: BCP-47 language code for result display. Set to the user's conversation language: "zh" for Chinese, "en" for English (or omit). Controls server-side localization and instructs Claude to apply the display mapping table when presenting results.

persona.description: Named analysis persona. Mutually exclusive with weights.

proposalId.description: On-chain proposal ID or Snapshot ID.

url.description: Snapshot proposal URL (snapshot.org or snapshot.box) or bare 0x proposal ID. Use this when the user pastes a link; do not ask for proposal ID or dao.

weights.description: Custom priority weights (0-100 integer each). Mutually exclusive with persona.
